headline: IQVIA (IQV) Shares Skyrocket, What You Need To Know
summary: Shares of clinical research company IQVIA (NYSE: IQV) jumped 12.9% in the morning session after the company reported second-quarter results that surpassed Wall Street's expectations and raised its full-year guidance. The company posted revenue of $4.37 billion, an 8.7% increase year-over-year, which beat estimates of $4.30 billion. Its adjusted earnings per share came in at $3.15, up 12.1% from the previous year and topping the consensus estimate of $3.03.
